gold_routing_table.divergence_reason: Default discipline routing would keep this with the Architect of Record; this project's delegation letter pulls the owner's rep in whenever both cost and schedule are affected, regardless of discipline. Every cell in this template carries a cost impact, so any schedule impact triggers the override.
